falsifier: the channel value is masked (& 0xff) instead of clamped
note: 0xa1 row: 'c v -> c'; v popped first; v clamped: (uint32)v > 255 -> 255; c' = c with bits 23..16 <- v; pushed as 0x15'. v = 256 > 255 clamps to 255 (a mask & 0xff would give 0): 0x11223344 with the green channel <- 0xff = 0x11ff3344. Helper: 0x48 pushes the colour.
